Our Core Export Line

Our Flagship Range.
Built for Four Industries.

As a merchant exporter, cow dung is our founding & flagship product line — sourced through a direct tie-up with a verified export-grade producer network and organized by application — agriculture, ritual, cremation & fuel. It's one of several categories we export; see our full sourcing capability, spanning spices, foods, ayurvedic products & more, further below. Custom packaging, private labelling & OEM available across the range.

Frequently Asked Questions

Buyer FAQs

Common questions from international importers and distributors.

What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ) for exports?

MOQ varies by product — typically 500 KG for powders and vermicompost, 1 MT for cow dung cakes and bulk fertilizers. For sample orders (5–25 kg), we can accommodate with sample charges. Contact us for specific product MOQs.

How can I verify your registrations before placing an order?

We hold valid GST, MSME, IEC and APEDA registrations — all verifiable with the Government of India. We're transparent about exactly what we hold and what's arranged per buyer-country requirement. We recommend starting with a small trial order or a sample. We'll provide all verifiable documents and are happy to connect via video call before any order.

What certifications do you provide with each shipment?

Each shipment comes with: Commercial Invoice, Packing List, Certificate of Origin (CoO), Phytosanitary Certificate (from NPPO India), and Bill of Lading. NPOP Organic and other buyer-specific certifications are arranged per country requirement — we will not claim certifications we don't hold.

Which payment terms do you accept?

We accept 100% Advance TT (Telegraphic Transfer), LC at Sight (Letter of Credit), and 30% Advance + 70% against BL copy for trusted repeat buyers. For first-time orders, we prefer 100% advance or LC at sight.

Which ports do you ship from?

As a merchant exporter, we ship from whichever port is nearest to the origin of your order — typically Visakhapatnam, Chennai, or Kolkata. We work with experienced freight forwarders for competitive rates and reliable sailing schedules.

Can you do private labelling and custom packaging?

Yes. We offer private labelling and OEM services. You can supply your brand artwork and we will print and pack products under your brand. Custom bag sizes, materials (HDPE, kraft paper, biodegradable), and insert labels are available with a minimum order.

How long does shipment take to reach my country?

Gulf countries: 7–12 days. South East Asia: 12–18 days. Europe: 20–28 days. USA/Canada: 25–35 days. Australia: 18–25 days. Production and packing: 7–15 days. Total lead time is typically 4–6 weeks from order confirmation.
